briefdescription.para: Comprehensive tests for GPU memory RAII patterns and lifecycle management.

detaileddescription.para:
Validates acceptance criteria for Batch 1 critical GPU memory fixes:
All use-after-free findings resolved with proper lifetime management
All GPU memory allocations protected by RAII wrappers
Zero uninitialized access patterns with test coverage > 90%
All changes follow ThemisDB C++ best practices (modern C++17, smart pointers, RAII)

Test Categories:
Memory Lifecycle (allocation/deallocation)
RAII Wrapper Semantics (move, copy, scope exit)
Exception Safety (cleanup on throw)
Error Handling (checked CUDA calls)
No Use-After-Free (moved-from detection)
Integration Tests (real GPU operations if available)
Target Coverage: >90% for GPU memory code paths
